title: 基福堂 Jifu Tang
subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: No box in the 3D view: the plan shows no building here, or a plot, water, a hill or a name only.

questions.title: S01 at 九洲清晏 carries names of 1873. For the next modelling round

evidence.title: 同治十二年 上谕: 九洲清晏 halls renamed (as quoted in S220)
evidence.locator: S220 section 五; archive not seen
evidence.excerpt_zh: 绮春园改名万春园，敷春堂改名天地一家春，悦心园改名和春园，清夏斋改名清夏堂，圆明园九州清晏同道堂改名福寿仁恩，基福堂改名思顺堂，天地一家春改名承恩堂。清夏堂西宫门改名南宫门。
evidence.summary: The decree of 1873 gives the new names of Tongzhi's repair: 同道堂 becomes 福寿仁恩, 基福堂 becomes 思顺堂, the old 天地一家春 becomes 承恩堂. All three new names are written on the plan S01 at 九洲清晏, where its older names are not. So those labels cannot be earlier than this decree, and they are not names of the target state of 1860.

evidence.title: 文宗實錄 opening: 基福堂 was earlier 湛静斋
evidence.locator: 卷一 opening (corpus copy line near the start)
evidence.link: https://github.com/garychowcmu/daizhigev20/blob/master/史藏/别史/清实录咸丰朝实录.txt
evidence.excerpt_zh: 以道光十一年辛卯。六月。初九日。丑时。诞上于御园之湛静斋。后更为基福堂者是也。
evidence.summary: Xianfeng was born in 1831 in 湛静斋, later renamed 基福堂: so 基福堂 is the name of the Xianfeng reign, and 湛静斋 the earlier one.

evidence.title: 基福堂: 咸丰五年 poem of the Xianfeng Emperor
evidence.date: 咸丰五年 (1855), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 御园钟粹两颜楣，生我劬劳念在兹。（子于辛卯六月九日生于御园之湛静斋，即今基福堂也。）考妣恩深何以报，敬勤志最敢时遗。修身身立诚艰矣，基福福臻倍惕之。孝心存如赤子音，容莫睹祇余悲
evidence.summary: Xianfeng, 1855: his note says he was born on the 9th day of the sixth month of 1831 in 湛静斋, the present 基福堂.

evidence.title: 基福堂: 咸丰五年 poem of the Xianfeng Emperor
evidence.date: 咸丰五年 (1855), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 诞育辛年曾此地，慈颜已十五春远。聊因怀旧寝兴所，那复承欢膝下依。父母俱存恸不胜，未能继志愧多增。何堪乐境成忧境，惟敬惟勤考眷承。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Xianfeng Emperor at 基福堂, 1855, on daily residence there. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 基福堂
evidence.locator: from p.128, under 九洲清晏
evidence.summary: A Xianfeng note of 1855 says he was born in 1831 in 湛静斋, which is the present 基福堂. 基福堂: 2 dated items, 1855-1855, of which 2 poems (Xianfeng); recurring themes: daily residence there, remembering his forebears. First dated 1855, last dated 1855.

evidence.title: 九洲清晏区域考古勘探报告
evidence.locator: mhymy 档案史料 12600, free part
evidence.summary: Survey report's opening: the island site measures 220 x 120 m (printed area 25,000 m2), with 8,600 m2 of buildings, 656 bays of halls and galleries in middle, east and west routes, not symmetrical. The earliest hall, 清晖阁 Qinghui Ge, is given as 1707, and building went on into Daoguang. The survey results themselves sit behind a paywall.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum and Historical Photographs of China; today's photographs on Commons.
